title: Iconic footballer Zinedine Zidane and ‘Les Bleus’: a love story with a bright future
summary: French-Algerian football icon Zinedine Zidane became the new manager of France’s national football team on Tuesday, bringing an end to what little suspense there was over Didier Deschamp’s successor. Zidane frequently stated his desire to take over the French team and much of the football world supported his ambitions.
